Only 23% of 4,441 remote listings reveal pay. Here's what that means for your job search.

Our latest data from Loker Dollar shows a striking trend: just 23% of remote job listings include a salary figure. That's 1,000 out of 4,441 active listings. The rest? 77% keep compensation private.

But here's the contrarian take: lack of pay info doesn't mean low wages. Many firms expect candidates to negotiate. So don't skip those listings—prepare your pitch.

Also notable: 62% of listings (2,753) are open to worldwide applicants. And communication tops the skill demand at 39%, followed by AI at 12%.

Ready to find a remote job that pays in USD? Browse the live board and filter for 'worldwide remote' before these listings close.
